## Activity

During July 2021, the River Outreach clinic team completed 21 captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded activity provides a clear basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the month. Teams should continue to record completed captures consistently and ensure that any operational concerns affecting image collection are noted through the usual reporting process. This supports monitoring of service delivery and helps identify issues that may require follow-up.

## Image quality

A total of 4 captures were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 19.0 per cent of captures. The result should be reviewed with the team to identify recurring causes, including any camera issues or other factors that may affect the usefulness of captured images. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be investigated and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. This provides an indication of the usual turnaround achieved at the site. The site should continue to monitor grading timeliness and image quality together, as both measures support timely review and appropriate follow-up of referable results.
